title: UsageWeightTable
description: The usage weight table of ADR-020 section 4: per species (a roster entry of the team vocabulary) integer weights of items, abilities, moves, Stat Point spreads and teammates, derived offline from one recorded monthly Smogon chaos file and committed as reviewed data. Aggregate numbers only: no team, replay or player name; the key evs is never used and no object is team-shaped, so the data-class guard treats it like the usage prior. Integers only. Every list is in parts per million of the species' own total for that list: its entries, its truncated mass (mapped mass the top-K cut dropped) and its unmapped mass (plus no_item for items and empty for moves) sum to exactly 1,000,000, and the species' usage_ppm values plus unmapped_species_ppm sum to 1,000,000. w_species and a teammate's weight are the exact integer root floor((ppm * 10^(6 * (r - 1)))^(1/r)) of the ppm with the table's species_root / teammate_root r, computed in the derivation, so r = 1 leaves the ppm. The reader enforces sorted and unique ids, the sums, the roots, the top-K limits and that every id resolves in the engine-data table and team vocabulary the table names by hash, which the profile cannot say. usageTableHash is the SHA-256 of the RFC 8785 bytes. A new month, cutoff or limit is a new table, never an edit.
